name: Keycap shortcut
oneLiner: big glossy physical keycaps sit under a window showing the brand's screen, they press down one by one and stay held with light leaking from beneath, the last one is the accent key: the deck bumps, a ring flies off it, the screen dims and a card lands with the action and the shortcut echoed in small caps, then the keys spring back up
say: when the speaker says it takes one shortcut or names the keys ('just hit control shift S', 'one keystroke and it is done'): each key presses as they say it, the card lands on what it does
